# Changelog

## 1.0.0 — Universal foundation

- Replaced application-specific repository-wide instructions with stack- and domain-neutral engineering guidance.
- Added a project profile and standard-library CI command runner.
- Added generic CI and GitHub configuration validation workflows.
- Added specialist agents, broader path-specific instructions, reusable prompts, and neutral operational runbooks.
- Added optional Dependabot ecosystem and workflow templates.
- Isolated any legacy project-specific instructions and deployment workflows from the distributable universal core.
- Added support matrix, product sheet, licensing template, and enterprise security setup guide.
